items.example: The invitation was meant for my immediate team only.
All 3,000 staff at the company got the invitation.
He was an intern at a large multinational company.
She works for a large multinational company.
He sent out a confidential internal email to the whole team.
The email went out to every single customer by accident.
She managed to upload a photo of her children instead of the sofa.
He uploaded a photo and tagged his ex in it.
She advertised a sofa for sale in the local newspaper.
She presumed the plant would almost reach the ceiling.
The plant was measured in centimetres and meant for a doll's house.
He turned up in 1960s clothes with a long-haired wig.
He sent the email without checking the recipient's name.
He got an official verbal warning but no further action.
He was worried they might fire him after the mistake.
The company offered her a full refund for the cake.
The room they were given was not fit for purpose.
An alternative cake had to be purchased in haste.
The flight was over-booked and there were no seats left.
